ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is created as part of STY-02249.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT( $Permission.NSP_FLSA ), $User.NSP_Profile_Name__c <>'System Administrator', $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.CaseValidations__c != true, CONTAINS( $Label.NSP_FLSA_Case_Sub_Categories, NSP_SubCategory__c), NSP_Category__c = 'HR Admin Compliance - FLSA')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only the FLSA Group can create this type of case. If your client needs this service, please contact the FLSA Group.
